`tone-44100.mp3` is a synthetic 440 Hz sine wave (0.3 seconds, stereo,
44.1 kHz, 64 kbit/s), generated for the decoder regression test:

```sh
ffmpeg -f lavfi -i 'sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=44100:duration=0.3' \
  -ac 2 -codec:a libmp3lame -b:a 64k -map_metadata -1 tone-44100.mp3
```

All other audio fixtures are generated by the test in a temporary directory.
No third-party music or user audio is included.
